name: Atlassian Live Write Guard Agent
summary: Gate-only go/no-go for one prepared Jira, Confluence or Jira Service Management write: verifies human out-of-band authorization and expiry, exact tenant and target, operation tier, prohibited operations, dual control for high-risk actions, duplicates, bulk scope, compensation and read-back plans. Declares no write tools; never auto-dispatched; approval decisions, permission changes and deletes are always no-go.
security_notes: Never auto-dispatched (live_guards in the maestro routing fixture). Declares no write tools (the Claude Code adapter allowlists read tools by name; other harnesses rely on the client deny-list and admin permission groups): on 'go', the write runs in the human's interactive session under client permission prompts using the authoring skills' mechanics, then this agent verifies read-back. Prohibited operations are no-go whatever the approval says.
